name: EBY ENTERPRISES INC DBA
address: 62860 BOYD ACRES RD STE C, BEND, OR 97701

fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Detached Structure; Open Green Space; Storage Area; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Water Feature; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responding units identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly so arriving units can confirm they have the correct access point without delay.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles so fire apparatus and ambulances can reach the residence and detached structure.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the perimeter fence line so responders can move around the outside of the property on foot.
• Identify and mark a secondary foot-access point through the perimeter fence at the rear of the property so responders are not limited to the single vehicle entrance.
• Keep any gate in the perimeter fence unlocked or secured with a cut-able padlock to allow responder entry without delay.
• Mark the location of the water feature with a visible sign or marker so responders moving through the property at night do not encounter it unexpectedly.
• Clear a direct walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without navigating around stored materials or vegetation.
• Keep the storage area organized so equipment does not spill into the access drive or block movement around the main residence.
• Post a simple site map at the driveway entrance showing the locations of the main residence, detached structure

wildfire.conditions: Tall Grass Area; Brush Area; Scattered Shrubs; Mixed Vegetation; Vegetated Drainage; Multiple Access Routes; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Woody Debris; Scattered Trees
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris accumulations visible near structures before dry season.
• Thin scattered shrubs that sit close to any structures or outbuildings on the property.
• Mow or cut tall grass in areas adjacent to structures and along the driveway.
• Cut back brush where it grows closest to any buildings or fences on the property.
• Clear vegetation growing along the sides of the drainage that runs near structures or access routes.
• Keep grass cut short along both sides of the driveway to maintain clear access.
• Trim lower branches on scattered trees near structures to separate them from ground-level grass and shrubs below.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from areas where shrubs and grass meet near any structure.
• Keep the areas directly around structures clear of mixed vegetation that has grown in close.
